d:
Bollywood veteran Raza Murad is here with a treasure trove of fascinating stories from the world of Hindi cinema!
In this special episode of The Lallantop's Guest In The Newsroom, Raza Murad talks about Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, Ranveer Singh, Ranbir Kapoor, Rajesh Khanna, Dilip Kumar and Rajkumar.
Ranveer or Ranbir – who is the better actor? Who could become the next superstar after Shah Rukh Khan? And what are the stories behind Bollywood's biggest legends?
From hilarious anecdotes to lesser-known stories and fascinating memories, Raza Murad has plenty to share.
